intro.title: About Playa de la Malagueta
intro.entityEquivalence: Welcome to Playa de la Malagueta, widely recognized as the central Playa la Malagueta. Located in the heart of Málaga, Andalucía, Spain, this destination serves as a primary hub for travellers visiting the Costa del Sol region.
intro.description: Playa de la Malagueta is one of the most iconic urban beaches in Málaga, located on the Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso. This golden-sand beach sits close to the city centre and offers an easy place to enjoy the sun and the Mediterranean Sea, being a favourite destination for both locals and visitors. Public showers, a children's playground, sun lounger and umbrella rental, lifeguard service, and wheelchair access are all available.

nearby.title: Landmarks & Attractions Around Playa la Malagueta
nearby.description: When visiting Playa de la Malagueta, visitors can easily explore surrounding historical landmarks and points of interest, including the iconic Plaza de Toros de La Malagueta and the renowned Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso, as well as the Port of Málaga and the Málaga Old Town within walking distance.

sections.title: History & Significance of Playa de la Malagueta
sections.content: Playa de la Malagueta has been for decades one of the main civic meeting points in Málaga. Its name derives from the historic La Malagueta neighbourhood, and it has become a living symbol of the Málaga coastline, pioneering urban beach services in the city and defining the Andalusian summer coastal culture.

sections.title: Location & How to Visit Playa la Malagueta in Málaga
sections.content: The beach is located on the Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso, in the Málaga-Este district, postal code 29016. It features a wide pedestrian promenade ideal for strolling, a segregated bicycle lane, shaded rest areas, and an excellent array of chiringuitos and seafood restaurants facing the Mediterranean Sea.

sections.title: Landmarks & Attractions Around Playa la Malagueta
sections.content: As one of the most popular urban beaches on the Costa del Sol, La Malagueta hosts numerous summer events, sports activities, and community gatherings, serving as a reference point for Málaga's coastal identity. In its immediate vicinity stand the Plaza de Toros de La Malagueta, the Port of Málaga, and the museum district of the historic city centre.

sections.title: Services, Facilities & Visitor Amenities
sections.content: The beach features sun loungers and beach umbrellas for rent, public showers and changing rooms, seasonal lifeguard and rescue post, dining at the beach chiringuitos, a children's playground, and accessible ramps for people with reduced mobility. The promenade provides ample zones for leisure, outdoor exercise, and shaded rest benches.

items.question: Where is Playa de la Malagueta located?
items.answer: Playa de la Malagueta is located in Málaga, Andalucía, Spain, specifically at P.º Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso in the Málaga-Este district, postal code 29016. Its geographic coordinates are latitude 36.7176651 N, longitude 4.4082141 W.

items.question: Is Playa la Malagueta free to visit?
items.answer: Yes. Playa de la Malagueta is a municipal public beach and is completely free to access 365 days a year, 24 hours a day. Additional services such as sun lounger rental, beach umbrellas, or chiringuito dining are paid commercial offerings available at the visitor's discretion.

items.question: What visitor facilities does Playa de la Malagueta provide?
items.answer: Playa de la Malagueta is equipped with a comprehensive suite of amenities: public showers and changing rooms, a children's playground, seasonal sun lounger and umbrella rental, professional lifeguard coverage during summer months, wheelchair accessible ramps, beach chiringuitos (restaurants), and a fully segregated pedestrian promenade with bicycle lane, rest benches, and landscaped green belts.
